messages:
Ethan Kim: Hey folks, Ethan here (backend). Quick security/setup qs for my first day: 1) Which learning modules are blocking access to eng-dedicated channels? 2) I got a phishing simulation notice but my laptop is delayed — can I be exempt until I get a company device? 3) How do I check disk encryption on macOS and Windows?

Ruth (People Ops): welcome Ethan! :wave: Mandatory: Security Basics + Data Handling are required to be completed within 72h to get full channel access. For phish sims we have a loaner/exempt flow — reply with "loaner-request" here and Facilities will follow up.

Ilya IT: @Ethan - for macOS run `fdesetup status`. For Windows (BitLocker) open an elevated PowerShell and run:
```
manage-bde -status C:\\
```
If encryption is off we can either push MDM and require FileVault/BitLocker, or we can provide a loaner VM/hardware. Send your delivery tracking and we'll hold off enrollment until you confirm.

Ethan Kim: fdesetup output: "FileVault is Off". My pickup ETA pushed to next week. Ill do loaner-request for now. Also, does enrolling personal Mac in Jamf put corporate certs on it? I prefer minimal footprint.

Ilya IT: The temporary profile is minimal: disk encryption enforcement, password policy, and MDM check-in. No enterprise VPN or email certs unless you opt-in. We only push SSO certs for company devices.

Morgan InfoSec: MFA is separate from device enrollment — please complete identity MFA as soon as you get the invite. For phishing sims: if you have a loaner you will be included; otherwise we defer you. We do periodic baseline sims in week 1 and month 1.

PhishSimBot: User Ethan Kim scheduled for simulated phishing cohort on 2026-04-08. Reply "loaner-request" to request exemption until a managed device is assigned.

Ethan Kim: loaner-request. Also, can Facilities leave the loaner with USB-C charger and a privacy screen?

Facilities Bot: Loaner request received for Ethan Kim. Facilities will attempt delivery 2 business days after approval. Amenities: charger + optional privacy screen if requested. Please confirm pickup or delivery preference via the facilities form: https://redwood.intranet/facilities/loaner-form.

Ruth (People Ops): Marked Ethan as exempt for the upcoming phishing cohort and added to the onboarding tracker. Welcome to the team! :tada:

Ethan Kim: Thanks everyone — will enable FileVault on my personal machine for now and follow the loaner flow. Appreciate the quick help!
